gaps: Every breath-one witness is added to a world that otherwise leaves the fact alone. Sharpening Refractory blink against storage produced a witness whose job is to discard: the trigger, which must be told what to expect before anything is written. This produced the changed question for breath two: what a witness must be built not to do.
accepted: Refractory blink: a detector must recover faster than events arrive or two close arrivals fuse into one count, as a Geiger tube's dead time swallows the second of two near-simultaneous decays; not a sensitivity problem, since a loud event vanishes just as completely if it lands inside the recovery.

Enough bodies: a difference in rate leaves no trace in a population too small for the rare case to occur even once, as a one-in-a-hundred-thousand harm cannot appear in a trial of three thousand; not instrument sensitivity but the count of chances, so the missing witness is a denominator.

Mine for silence: a faint difference registers only after the dominant signal is removed rather than the faint one amplified, as neutrino detectors sit under a kilometer of rock and stars appear only when the sun is gone; the witness is a subtraction, and no gain in sensitivity reaches below the floor the background sets.

Second ear: a single instrument cannot tell the world from its own twitch, so the record is the coincidence of two detectors of different make far enough apart to share no twitch, as the paired gravitational-wave sites do; not replication for confidence, but the only witness to the difference between signal and instrument.

Common meter: two observers can discover that they differ only against a third thing both compare to, a standard bar, a shared clock, a benchmark bolted into bedrock for the next century's surveyor; not a counterpart that differs from the object, but a reference that stays put while the object and the observer both move.

Untouched twin: a difference is recordable only as a difference from something, so a cured patient witnesses nothing until an untreated counterpart exists that differs from her only in the treatment; not more measurement of the treated case, but the manufacture of a second case.

Room for strangers: a pattern spread across separately held private memories becomes recordable only in a setting where strangers can compare them, as eight tenants each know one eviction and none knows a landlord; not a matter of how many memories exist, but of whether the comparison operation has anywhere to happen.

Writable counterexample: a refutation cannot exist until a notation exists in which the offending object can be stated, as a continuous nowhere-differentiable curve was unstatable before functions could be arbitrary rules and limits could be written uniformly; not a proof but a language, and the difference was real for decades before it could be written.

Cage for the proof: the difference between not yet proven and unprovable leaves a trace only once the proof system is itself a finite object that can be reasoned about, as the continuum hypothesis became independent rather than merely open; a witness for a negative, and the only kind that can record that a search will never succeed.

Burial lottery: a soft body leaves a trace only where anoxic mud, rapid burial, and absent scavengers coincide, so the fossil record witnesses depositional regimes before it witnesses animals; an absence in the record is first an absence of the regime, and the witness was built by accident of geography rather than by anyone.

Deputized injury: a tribunal registers a harm only when some person entitled to bring it exists, so a poisoned commons injures everyone and therefore no one with standing; not a lack of evidence, since the record may be complete while the court stays deaf until a qualified bearer of the injury speaks.

Arm's-length custody: a fact about an institution registers only if a copy of its record lives beyond the institution's reach, in a notary's book, an escrow, a log written to a server the subject cannot touch; not whether the record exists but who can delete it, and a perfect record in the accused's drawer witnesses nothing.

residue.item: Roll call: a disappearance registers only if the disappeared was enrolled beforehand.
residue.why: Rejected: already carried by Missing alarm in traces-of-the-unlived, where a stored expectation makes a nonarrival detectable; the witness-architecture reading adds no new burden beyond prior enrollment.

residue.item: Stake in the ground: a benchmark or fixed photographic station that outlives every observer so a slow change can register.
residue.why: Merged into Common meter: a reference stable across generations is the same third-thing mechanism as a reference stable across laboratories; its case survives as the bedrock benchmark.

residue.item: Height for the horizon: a vantage from which the shape of the Earth becomes visible.
residue.why: Rejected: a place to stand is a location for an existing eye, not a new kind of witness; what it adds is carried by Second ear (a separated second eye) or Mine for silence (removal of the foreground).

residue.item: Protected reporter: a channel through which a witness can speak without retaliation.
residue.why: Held: as an obligation it is question-metamorphoses' Harbor before testimony; as an architecture it splits between hiding the reporter and holding the record beyond the retaliator's reach. Resolved in breath two into The hide and Arm's-length custody rather than admitted whole.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real case usually needs several of these witnesses at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.
The seriation is an itinerary of how far the witness must be shaped against the difference, not a ranking of difficulty, cost, or historical order; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (collider trigger, Burgess-type burial, paired interferometers, stack monitoring, secret ballots) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories.
Ledger that makes the debt is analytical about performative facts only; whether any physical difference is constituted by its witness is deliberately left outside the list.
Witness-destroying arrangements (censorship, dead-letter drops, records sealed forever) are outside except where destruction doubles as construction, as in the tally.

gaps: The changed question yielded witnesses that must refuse (Trigger's blind spot, The hide, Blindfolded tally), be consumed (Half kept back), be paid for by the guilty (Silence priced as guilt), and finally constitute the fact (Ledger that makes the debt). The territory pointer 'witness architectures' stands, but the of-sentence now includes what the witness must be built not to see and when building it makes the fact. An invented world in which only the accused may build detectors dissolved into an observed arrangement, stack monitoring with gaps scored as worst case, and became Silence priced as guilt.
accepted: Half kept back: a reading that consumes its specimen can register only if a duplicate was reserved before the reading, as radiocarbon dating burns the sample and split-sample rules keep a sealed half; the witness architecture includes one copy to destroy and one to keep, and the reservation must precede the question.

Trigger's blind spot: a recorder flooded past its storage must decide before writing what to keep, so a difference nobody anticipated is discarded before it exists on disk, as a collider's trigger drops nearly every collision by design; not dead time, which is capacity, but selection, and the witness must be told what to expect.

Silence priced as guilt: when only the party at fault can host the instrument, as with a smokestack monitor, the witness registers only under a rule that scores a gap in the record as the worst possible reading, so that not witnessing costs more than being witnessed; not custody, which is who may delete, but an arrangement that makes the accused build.

The hide: the witness must be concealed from the witnessed for the natural difference to appear, as in a birdwatcher's blind, a one-way mirror, or an assessor who does not know which patient got the drug; built blindness pointing outward, and the concealed part remains recoverable by someone holding the key.

Blindfolded tally: some aggregate facts register truthfully only through a witness built so that it cannot see the parts, as a secret ballot records the electorate only because no one can record a voter; built blindness pointing inward, and unlike the hide there is no key, since recoverability would falsify the aggregate.

Ledger that makes the debt: past the level of recording, some differences exist only because their witness exists, as a debt without a ledger or a marriage without a registry is not an unrecorded fact but no fact, so building the witness constitutes what it records; analytical about performative facts, with no claim that physical measurement creates what it measures.

residue.item: Observer that makes the state: measurement constitutes the physical difference it records.
residue.why: Rejected: would promote a contested physical interpretation into Ledger that makes the debt; the ledger item is kept to performative facts and its boundary claim says so.

residue.item: Recombined beams: a phase difference between two paths registers only when the paths are brought together to interfere.
residue.why: Merged into Room for strangers: the same bringing-together mechanism at another scale; noted so that the room item is read as a comparison operation rather than a headcount.

residue.item: Memory of the crowd: a reputational fact registers only where an audience exists that can remember and be embarrassed.
residue.why: Rejected: its burden decomposes into Room for strangers and Arm's-length custody; no new thing must be built.

residue.item: Relay of the dying: an invented world where every record decays at the rate of what it records, so slow change is witnessed only by a chain of hand-offs.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: strange and possibly fertile, but the hand-off chain is a version of Common meter unless the relay itself alters the difference; it needs a mechanism by which handing off changes the fact before admission.

neighbors.separating_case: An anonymous suggestion box with a concealed camera: the witness is hidden from the complainer, so it is a hide, and the natural complaint appears; but the witness sees who complained, so it is no tally, and the honest aggregate of complaints about a supervisor still fails to register. Outward blindness does not buy inward blindness, and the hide keeps a key the tally must not have.

checks.boundary_case: A more sensitive version of an instrument that already registers the difference is out: the difference already left a faint trace, so a better microscope is amplification, not a new kind of witness. Mine for silence is in on exactly that contrast, since removing the background lets a difference register that no gain in sensitivity could reach.
checks.form_inference: The map shows an incompatibility the sequence conceals: The hide and Blindfolded tally sit as neighbors on the itinerary, but the edge between them says that past a point one arrangement cannot be both, since a witness hidden from the parties and blind to the parties can audit neither. It shows a passage between levels at Blindfolded tally → Ledger that makes the debt, where a witness built to see only the sum stops recording and starts constituting. And it shows two loops the line cannot express: Refractory blink → Trigger's blind spot, where curing capacity blindness recreates blindness as selection, and Cage for the proof → Writable counterexample, where a witness for a negative sends the field back to notation-building.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct thing that must be built and a distinct failure when it is absent; the strange members (a witness that must not see, a rule that prices silence, a witness for a negative) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into general advice about better instruments.

next_crossfield_opening: Witnesses built to be blind: connect Blindfolded tally with question-metamorphoses' Question sanctuary and traces-of-the-unlived's Unassembled witness; ask which facts exist only for a witness that cannot see their parts, and whether such a witness can ever be audited without being destroyed.

Folding it in collapsed a three-way structure into a binary, and the hide → tally edge claimed an incompatibility ('neither concealment can audit the other') that is only a difference; the real incompatibility is on the key axis, as the author's own suggestion-box case shows. residue.why: Offered as an observation from the boundary probe, not as a repair; 'leave a trace at all' already reads as registration in every item, so the of-sentence is left as authored.

limits: Lineage carried here because the brief fixes parents to []: the map is the cultivation of question-metamorphoses' Unborn witness ('What must first be built so their difference can leave a trace?'), and Room for strangers is the constructive twin of traces-of-the-unlived's Unassembled witness (same mechanism, same tenant-class case, read from what must be built rather than what preemption prevents), kept because the standing edge needs it.

Edges relabeled: hide → tally now states the incompatibility on the key axis; blink → trigger now closes the loop through the trigger's own readout dead time; cage → writable is a return one level up, not a loop. Seriation reordered as argued (Burial lottery after Enough bodies; Writable counterexample and Cage for the proof after Trigger's blind spot); hinge and endpoints unchanged. No items cut.
seed: The middle built-blindness the map contains only by accident: a witness kept from seeing the parts under a sealed key that is opened after it has spoken (the blinded assessor, the sealed-bid auction, the double-blind peer review). Between the hide (key kept) and the tally (key destroyed) lies an axis of when the key may be turned, and it asks whether a timed key is a third kind of witness or a tally with an expiry, and whether any inward-blind witness can be audited without being unmade, which is the map's own crossfield opening restated as an architecture.
